title: Choose the visual world — Intention Massage Academy
question: The roll assigned The Assessment Form. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Assessment Form
options.lineage: the clinical intake sheet and front/back body chart every therapist fills in before touching anyone
options.thesis: The academy page is the assessment form: you choose a course by marking where on the body it lives.
materials: carbonless NCR duplicate paper (white, canary, pink copies)
form ink printed in one deep green
options.viewport: A giant front/back body chart printed on the form. The five one-day CPD courses are red ballpoint marks on the shoulder, pelvis, head, low back and knee. Tap one and the form's 'treatment plan' field fills with that course, its £250 fee and a WhatsApp booking button.
options.risk: If the hand-drawn marks get timid or cute, it reads like a clinic leaflet rather than a masterclass.

raised.raise: The course list is a strictly ruled form table (course · region · days · fee · book) whose columns never move.
Red ballpoint is reserved for one job only: marking a course and booking it.
Touching the chart has consequence: the pen hatches the region you press, live.
The page runs in the form's fixed section order (A. Practitioner, B. Courses, C. Workshop, D. Booking), so the order itself is the navigation.

options.label: Fascial Line Map
options.lineage: the myofascial meridian charts (continuous coloured lines from foot to skull) taught in Rolfing and structural integration
options.thesis: Every course is a coloured line on a transit-style map of the body's fascial chains.
options.viewport: A full-height figure whose fascial lines run as coloured transit lines. Each CPD course is a station on its line, and the Deep Tissue two-day course is the interchange.
options.risk: It's beautiful but abstract. Therapists without structural-integration training may read it as decoration rather than as a course list.

options.label: Suminagashi Basin
options.thesis: The page as a basin of ink that your fingertip moves.
options.viewport: A WebGL ink basin with the course list held in the margin.
options.case: Fuses poorly: therapists don't recognise themselves in marbling, and the course offer disappears into the effect.
options.kept: Touch with real physical consequence. The chart hatches where you press.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Courses as departures on a flap board.
options.viewport: A departure board of CPD courses.
options.case: Fuses poorly: there are no published dates, so a timetable would be invented data.
options.risk: It needs a schedule that doesn't exist.
options.kept: Strict ruled rows and columns that never move.

options.label: Creator Hardware Bench
options.thesis: Courses as keys on a gunmetal console.
options.viewport: A keycap grid of courses with one orange 'book' key.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it's cold and gadget-like, the opposite of informed touch.
options.kept: One colour reserved for the single action that matters.

options.label: Kaiju Broadcast Alert
options.thesis: The academy as an emergency broadcast.
options.viewport: A title card cutting to a map with one arrow.
options.case: Declined: alarm is the opposite of a calm, grounding teacher.
options.kept: A fixed broadcast order used as navigation.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.viewport: A WebGL disk with orbiting labels.
options.case: Declined: no link to bodywork or to therapists.
options.kept: Nothing structural. It gave no raise.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: Scroll as a camera sinking through painted layers.
options.viewport: Parallax forest toward a lit cottage.
options.case: Declined: it drifts toward spa-retreat mood and hides the clinical depth that therapists pay for.
options.kept: Its depth rhythm was already covered by the form's sections.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A calm wellness-academy site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A full-bleed photo of hands at work, a serif headline, 'View courses', and course cards below.
canonCard.risk: It looks like every spa and massage school in Brighton.
